description: Applications do not validate, sanitize, or constrain input data before processing. This signal indicates that applications may be vulnerable to injection attacks, buffer overflows, or other input-based exploits.
applicability: Applicable to any application accepting external input including web applications, APIs, command-line tools, and data processing systems. Includes form inputs, API parameters, file uploads, and data imports.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through code review, static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), and penetration testing.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Information Integrity
